  --f: #14381e; --fm: #1e5030; --fl: #267040; --fp: #eaf5ec;
  --l: #28b85a; --ll: #8ee0a8; --lp: #d4f0dd;
  --honey: #c8780a; --honey2: #e8960c; --hp: #fff6e0;
  --clay: #a83418; --cp: #fdf0eb;
  --vi: #5028a0; --vp: #f0ebff;
  --co: #0860a0; --cop: #e8f4fd;
  --sage: #5a7840; --sp: #ecf5e4;
  --cream: #f5f0e6; --paper: #fafaf5; --white: #fff;
  --g50: #f2f0e8; --g100: #e0ddd0; --g200: #c4c0b0; --g300: #9a9888; --g400: #706e60; --g500: #504e40;
  --r-xs: 3px; --r-sm: 6px; --r-md: 12px; --r-lg: 20px; --r-xl: 32px; --r-pill: 999px;
  --pd: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  --body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: 'Space Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body { font-family: var(--body); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); overflow-x: hidden; line-height: 1.6; }
a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--body); border: none; background: none; }
img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
.wrap { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
.serif { font-family: var(--pd); }
.mono { font-family: var(--mono); }
.eyebrow { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.eyebrow::before { content: ''; display: block; width: 20px; height: 1.5px; background: currentColor; flex-shrink: 0; }
.section-title { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: clamp(26px,4vw,44px); font-weight: 900; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.section-title.light { color: #fff; }
.section-sub { font-size: 14px; color: var(--g400); margin-bottom: 20px; }
.section-sub.light { color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); }
.btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); cursor: pointer; transition: all .18s; border: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.btn-forest { background: var(--f); color: #fff; }
.btn-forest:hover { background: var(--fm); }
.btn-honey { background: var(--honey); color: #fff; }
.btn-honey:hover { background: #a86308; }
.btn-outline { background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid var(--g200); color: var(--ink); }
.btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--f); color: var(--f); }
.btn-outline-white { background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4); color: #fff; }
.btn-outline-white:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); }
.btn-sm { padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 12px; }
.btn-lg { padding: 14px 32px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; }
.reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); transition: opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease; }
.reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 2: NAVIGATION
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#nav { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 900; background: rgba(10,16,6,.96); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06); }
.nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 60px; padding: 0 24px; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
.nav-brand { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-right: auto; }
.nav-links { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.nav-link { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); cursor: pointer; transition: .15s; }
.nav-link:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
.nav-right { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-left: 20px; align-items: center; }
.nav-icon-btn { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); background: transparent; transition: .15s; }
.nav-icon-btn:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); }
.nav-cart-btn { position: relative; }
.cart-dot { position: absolute; top: -2px; right: -2px; width: 18px; height: 18px; background: var(--honey); border-radius: 50%; color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; display: none; }
.cart-dot.show { display: flex; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 3: HERO
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#hero { height: 100vh; min-height: 700px; background: #0a1006; position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.hero-canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 1; opacity: .3; }
.hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 3; flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 80px 0; }
.hero-inner { max-width: 680px; }
.mood-pills { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 28px; }
.mood-pill { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); color: rgba(255,255,255,.55); background: rgba(0,0,0,.3); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); cursor: pointer; transition: .25s; }
.mood-pill:hover, .mood-pill.active { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,.15); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); }
.hero-eyebrow { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.hero-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 24px; height: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.4); }
.hero-h1 { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: clamp(42px,7vw,92px); font-weight: 900; color: #fff; line-height: .95; letter-spacing: -.03em; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.hero-accent { display: block; color: var(--honey2); transition: color 1s; }
.hero-sub { font-size: 16px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); max-width: 440px; line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 32px; }
.hero-ctas { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.hero-trust-strip { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,.4); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); padding: 14px 0; z-index: 3; }
.hts-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; padding: 0 24px; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
.hts-inner::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.hts-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 20px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hts-item:last-child { border-right: none; }
.hts-icon { font-size: 16px; }
.hts-text { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.55); font-weight: 500; }
.hts-val { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); font-weight: 700; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 4: WHY BUY
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#why-buy { background: var(--ink); padding: 80px 0; }
.wb-title { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: clamp(28px,4vw,52px); font-weight: 900; color: #fff; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.wb-title em { color: var(--honey2); font-style: italic; }
.wb-sub { font-size: 15px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); text-align: center; max-width: 500px; margin: 0 auto 48px; line-height: 1.7; }
.wb-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: var(--r-xl); overflow: hidden; }
.wb-card { padding: 36px 28px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06); position: relative; transition: background .3s; }
.wb-card:last-child { border-right: none; }
.wb-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); }
.wb-number { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; color: rgba(255,255,255,.04); position: absolute; top: -4px; left: 8px; pointer-events: none; }
.wb-art { height: 100px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 20px; position: relative; font-size: 48px; }
.wb-claim { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: clamp(20px,2.5vw,28px); font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.15; }
.wb-claim em { color: var(--honey2); font-style: italic; }
.wb-body { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); line-height: 1.7; }
.wb-stat { margin-top: 16px; padding: 12px 14px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); border-radius: var(--r-md); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06); }
.wb-stat-num { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--honey2); line-height: 1; }
.wb-stat-lbl { font-size: 10px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.35); margin-top: 2px; font-family: var(--mono); letter-spacing: .5px; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 5: PRODUCTS
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#products { background: var(--paper); padding: 80px 0; }
.prod-filters { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 24px 0 32px; }
.pfv5 { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 18px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); border: 1.5px solid var(--g100); background: var(--white); color: var(--g400); cursor: pointer; transition: .15s; }
.pfv5:hover, .pfv5.on { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); color: #fff; }
.prod-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px,1fr)); gap: 28px; }
.pc5 { background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-xl); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--g100); cursor: pointer; transition: .25s; }
.pc5:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(15,20,9,.12); border-color: transparent; }
.pc5-vis { height: 220px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.pc5-vis-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; transition: transform .6s; }
.pc5:hover .pc5-vis-bg { transform: scale(1.04); }
.pc5-art { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-size: 72px; }
.pc5-badges { position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; z-index: 2; }
.pc5-badge { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); font-weight: 700; }
.pb-season-peak { background: var(--f); color: #fff; }
.pb-season-limited { background: var(--clay); color: #fff; }
.pb-season-rare { background: var(--vi); color: #fff; }
.pb-gi { background: rgba(200,120,10,.9); color: #fff; }
.pc5-qty-note { position: absolute; bottom: 14px; right: 14px; z-index: 2; background: rgba(10,16,6,.75); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-radius: var(--r-pill); padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
.pc5-body { padding: 20px 22px 22px; }
.pc5-category { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--g300); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.pc5-name { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 3px; line-height: 1.1; }
.pc5-tagline { font-size: 13px; color: var(--g400); margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 1.55; }
.pc5-claim { background: var(--ink); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 14px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.pc5-claim-bg { position: absolute; right: 10px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); font-size: 52px; opacity: .06; pointer-events: none; }
.pc5-claim-main { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.1; }
.pc5-claim-main span { color: var(--honey2); }
.pc5-claim-sub { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); }
.pc5-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.pc5-price-wrap { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; }
.pc5-price { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--f); }
.pc5-price-note { font-size: 11px; color: var(--g300); }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 6: PRODUCT MODAL
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.overlay { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(8,12,4,.8); z-index: 800; overflow-y: auto; padding: 24px 16px; backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }
.overlay.open { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; }
.modal-v5 { background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-xl); max-width: 860px; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
.mv5-close { position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 16px; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); border: none; color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: .15s; z-index: 10; }
.mv5-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.2); color: #fff; }
.mv5-hero { background: var(--ink); padding: 32px; display: flex; gap: 32px; align-items: center; }
.mv5-art { width: 120px; height: 120px; flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: var(--r-lg); background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); font-size: 64px; }
.mv5-info { flex: 1; }
.mv5-eyebrow { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,.3); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.mv5-claim-big { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: clamp(22px,3vw,36px); font-weight: 900; color: #fff; line-height: 1.05; }
.mv5-claim-big span { color: var(--honey2); }
.mv5-tagline { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); line-height: 1.65; }
.mv5-body { padding: 28px; }
.mv5-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g100); margin-bottom: 24px; overflow-x: auto; }
.mv5-tab { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; border-bottom: 2.5px solid transparent; color: var(--g400); cursor: pointer; transition: .15s; white-space: nowrap; }
.mv5-tab:hover, .mv5-tab.on { color: var(--f); border-bottom-color: var(--f); }
.mv5-panel { display: none; }
.mv5-panel.on { display: block; animation: fadeIn .2s; }
@keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.why-box { background: var(--ink); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 20px; margin-bottom: 18px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.wb-item { padding: 14px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); border-radius: var(--r-md); }
.wb-item-icon { font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.wb-item-title { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.wb-item-body { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); line-height: 1.55; }
.vis-compare { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: var(--r-md); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--g100); }
.vc-col { padding: 16px; }
.vc-col.theirs { background: var(--g50); }
.vc-col.ours { background: var(--fp); }
.vc-label { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
.vc-col.theirs .vc-label { color: var(--g400); }
.vc-col.ours .vc-label { color: var(--f); }
.vc-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
.vc-list li { font-size: 12px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink3); line-height: 1.4; }
.vc-list li::before { font-size: 10px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }
.vc-col.theirs .vc-list li::before { content: '✕'; color: var(--g300); }
.vc-col.ours .vc-list li::before { content: '✓'; color: var(--f); }
.recipe-steps { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.rs-step { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; background: var(--g50); border-radius: var(--r-md); }
.rs-num { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--f); color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
.rs-text { font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink3); line-height: 1.55; }
.ctx-calc { background: var(--g50); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.cc-title { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--f); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.cc-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--g400); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.cc-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.cc-control label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--g400); font-weight: 500; display: block; margin-bottom: 3px; }
.cc-input { border: 1.5px solid var(--g200); border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 7px 12px; font-size: 14px; background: var(--white); width: 90px; font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--ink); }
.cc-result { background: var(--f); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 14px 18px; }
.cc-result-main { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 3px; }
.cc-result-sub { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.55); }
.cc-note { font-size: 10px; color: var(--g300); margin-top: 8px; font-style: italic; font-family: var(--mono); }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 7: SEASONAL CSA
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#csa { background: var(--ink2); padding: 80px 0; color: #fff; }
.csa-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px,1fr)); gap: 18px; }
.csa-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 22px; transition: .2s; cursor: pointer; }
.csa-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.15); transform: translateY(-3px); }
.csa-season-badge { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: 14px; display: inline-block; }
.csa-open { background: rgba(40,184,90,.2); color: #8ee0a8; border: 1px solid rgba(40,184,90,.3); }
.csa-soon { background: rgba(200,120,10,.15); color: var(--honey2); border: 1px solid rgba(200,120,10,.3); }
.csa-name { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.csa-origin { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.csa-stages { display: flex; gap: 3px; margin-top: 6px; }
.csa-stage-dot { flex: 1; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.15); transition: .5s; }
.csa-stage-dot.done { background: #28b85a; }
.csa-stage-dot.active { background: var(--honey2); animation: stagePulse 2s infinite; }
@keyframes stagePulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: .4; } }
.csa-photo { font-size: 10px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.35); font-family: var(--mono); margin-top: 6px; }
.csa-reserve-btn { width: 100%; margin-top: 14px; padding: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); border-radius: var(--r-sm); color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: .15s; }
.csa-reserve-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 8: RITUALS
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#rituals { background: var(--ink); padding: 80px 0; }
.rituals-title { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: clamp(28px,4vw,52px); font-weight: 900; color: #fff; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.rituals-title em { color: var(--honey2); font-style: italic; }
.rituals-sub { font-size: 15px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); text-align: center; max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto 48px; }
.ritual-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 24px; }
.ritual-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: var(--r-xl); overflow: hidden; transition: .2s; cursor: pointer; }
.ritual-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
.rc-vis { height: 160px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; }
.rc-mood-tag { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 12px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); background: rgba(0,0,0,.3); }
.rc-time { position: absolute; bottom: 12px; right: 12px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); }
.rc-body { padding: 18px 20px; }
.rc-name { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.rc-desc { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.rc-ingredients { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.rc-ing { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .5px; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); cursor: pointer; transition: .15s; }
.rc-ing:hover { background: rgba(200,120,10,.25); color: var(--honey2); }
.rc-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
.rc-kit-btn { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); background: var(--honey); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: .15s; }
.rc-kit-btn:hover { background: #a86308; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 9: WELLNESS SHOP
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#wellness { background: var(--f); padding: 80px 0; color: #fff; }
.wellness-moods { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6,1fr); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 32px; }
.wm-btn { border-radius: var(--r-xl); padding: 20px 12px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: .2s; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); }
.wm-btn:hover, .wm-btn.active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.15); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); }
.wm-icon { font-size: 28px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.wm-label { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); }
.wellness-products { display: none; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px,1fr)); gap: 16px; animation: fadeIn .3s ease; }
.wellness-products.visible { display: grid; }
.wp-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: .2s; }
.wp-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.25); }
.wp-emoji { font-size: 28px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.wp-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.wp-why { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); }
.wp-price { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--honey2); margin-top: 3px; font-weight: 700; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 10: DEMAND GRID
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#demand { background: var(--f); padding: 80px 0; color: #fff; }
.dg-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); border-radius: var(--r-lg); overflow: hidden; }
.dg-cell { background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); padding: 22px; }
.dg-cell-lbl { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,.28); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.dg-cell-val { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 3px; line-height: 1; }
.dg-cell-val.gv { color: #8ee0a8; }
.dg-cell-val.hv { color: var(--honey2); }
.dg-cell-val.bv { color: #85b7eb; }
.dg-cell-sub { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.35); line-height: 1.55; }
.dg-bar { height: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius: 2px; margin-top: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
.dg-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; transition: width 1.5s; }
.dg-fill.gf { background: rgba(40,184,90,.7); }
.dg-fill.hf { background: rgba(200,120,10,.7); }
.dg-fill.bf { background: rgba(55,138,221,.7); }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 11: DASHBOARD
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#dashboard { background: var(--paper); padding: 60px 0; }
.dash-wrapper { margin-top: 28px; border-radius: var(--r-xl); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--g100); background: var(--white); }
.dash-header { background: var(--ink2); padding: 14px 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }
.dh-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }
.dh-sub { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); }
.dh-live { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(40,184,90,.8); }
.dh-pulse { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #28b85a; animation: pulse 2s infinite; }
@keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: .4; } }
.dash-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr; min-height: 500px; background: var(--g50); }
.dash-side { background: var(--white); border-right: 1px solid var(--g100); padding: 16px 0; }
.dsec { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--g300); padding: 12px 16px 5px; }
.ditem { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 9px 14px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--g400); cursor: pointer; transition: .15s; border-left: 3px solid transparent; }
.ditem:hover { background: var(--g50); color: var(--ink); }
.ditem.on { background: var(--fp); color: var(--f); border-left-color: var(--f); font-weight: 600; }
.ditem-icon { font-size: 14px; width: 18px; text-align: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
.ditem-badge { margin-left: auto; background: var(--honey); color: #fff; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--mono); }
.dash-main { padding: 22px; overflow: auto; }
.dview { display: none; }
.dview.on { display: block; animation: fadeIn .2s; }
.metrics-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(130px,1fr)); gap: 11px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.mc { background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--g100); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 14px; }
.mc-lbl { font-size: 10px; color: var(--g400); margin-bottom: 4px; font-weight: 500; }
.mc-val { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 22px; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 2px; line-height: 1; }
.mc-val.gv { color: var(--f); }
.mc-val.av { color: var(--honey); }
.mc-sub { font-size: 10px; color: var(--g300); }
.escrow-flow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; overflow-x: auto; background: var(--hp); border: 1px solid rgba(200,120,10,.2); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.ef-node { background: var(--white); border: 1px solid rgba(200,120,10,.25); border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 7px 10px; text-align: center; min-width: 78px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.ef-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #7a4a05; line-height: 1.2; }
.ef-sub { font-size: 9px; color: var(--g400); margin-top: 2px; }
.ef-arr { color: var(--honey); font-size: 14px; padding: 0 2px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.ef-node.final { background: var(--f); border-color: var(--f); }
.ef-node.final .ef-label { color: var(--ll); }
.ef-node.final .ef-sub { color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); }
.dt { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }
.dt th { background: var(--g50); padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--g400); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g100); }
.dt td { padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g50); color: var(--ink); vertical-align: middle; }
.dt tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.dt tr:hover td { background: rgba(234,245,236,.5); }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 12: COST BUILDER
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#cost-builder { background: var(--cream); padding: 60px 0; }
.cost-builder { background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--g100); border-radius: var(--r-xl); padding: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.cb-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.cb-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink3); display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.cb-select { border: 1.5px solid var(--g100); border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); width: 100%; }
.cost-stack { border: 1px solid var(--g100); border-radius: var(--r-md); overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.cs-row { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 9px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g50); font-size: 12px; }
.cs-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; }
.cs-lbl { flex: 1; color: var(--ink2); }
.cs-val { font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 600; width: 80px; text-align: right; color: var(--ink); }
.cs-pct { font-size: 10px; color: var(--g300); width: 40px; text-align: right; font-family: var(--mono); }
.margin-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px,1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-top: 4px; }
.mc-card { border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 14px; text-align: center; }
.mc-primary { background: var(--f); color: #fff; }
.mc-green { background: var(--lp); }
.mc-gold { background: var(--hp); }
.mc-val { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 3px; }
.mc-lbl { font-size: 10px; opacity: .7; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 13: APMC BAZAR RATES
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#bazar-rates { background: var(--paper); padding: 40px 0; }
.bazar-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
.bazar-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
.bazar-table th { background: var(--f); color: #fff; padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.bazar-table td { padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g100); }
.bazar-table tr:hover td { background: var(--fp); }
.page-btn { margin: 2px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--g200); border-radius: var(--r-sm); background: var(--white); cursor: pointer; transition: .15s; }
.page-btn:hover { background: var(--f); color: #fff; border-color: var(--f); }
.page-btn.active { background: var(--f); color: #fff; border-color: var(--f); }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 14: CART
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#cart-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 980; background: rgba(8,12,4,.7); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); display: none; justify-content: flex-end; }
#cart-overlay.open { display: flex; }
.cart-drawer { width: min(420px, 100vw); background: var(--white); height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; animation: slideRight .3s ease; }
@keyframes slideRight { from { transform: translateX(100%); } to { transform: none; } }
.cart-head { padding: 20px 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g100); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.cart-head-title { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; flex: 1; }
.cart-count-badge { background: var(--honey); color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--mono); }
.cart-close-btn { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--g50); border: none; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--g400); }
.cart-close-btn:hover { background: var(--g100); color: var(--ink); }
.cart-items { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px 22px; }
.cart-item { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--g50); }
.cart-item-img { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: var(--r-md); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 28px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.cart-item-body { flex: 1; }
.cart-item-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.cart-item-origin { font-size: 10px; color: var(--g300); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.cart-item-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.qty-btn { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--g200); background: var(--white); font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--ink); transition: .15s; }
.qty-btn:hover { background: var(--f); color: #fff; border-color: var(--f); }
.qty-num { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; min-width: 20px; text-align: center; font-family: var(--mono); }
.cart-item-price { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--f); margin-left: auto; flex-shrink: 0; }
.cart-remove { font-size: 11px; color: var(--clay); cursor: pointer; margin-left: 8px; }
.cart-empty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 200px; gap: 12px; color: var(--g300); }
.cart-foot { padding: 18px 22px; border-top: 1px solid var(--g100); background: var(--g50); }
.cart-summary { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.cart-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 13px; padding: 4px 0; color: var(--g400); }
.cart-row.total { font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: var(--ink); border-top: 1px solid var(--g100); padding-top: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
.cart-row.total .cart-val { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 20px; color: var(--f); }
.cart-cta { width: 100%; padding: 14px; background: var(--f); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-sm); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: .15s; }
.cart-cta:hover { background: var(--fm); }
.cart-escrow-note { font-size: 10px; color: var(--g400); text-align: center; margin-top: 8px; line-height: 1.5; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 15: TOAST
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.notif-toast { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; z-index: 1000; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 320px; }
.toast { background: var(--ink); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; animation: toastIn .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.3); }
.toast.removing { animation: toastOut .3s ease forwards; }
@keyframes toastIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(40px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes toastOut { to { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(40px); height: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; } }
.toast-icon { font-size: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }
.toast-body { flex: 1; }
.toast-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.toast-sub { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); }
.toast-close { color: rgba(255,255,255,.3); cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; align-self: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
.toast-close:hover { color: #fff; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 16: FOOTER
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
footer { background: var(--ink2); color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); padding: 60px 0 32px; }
.footer-main { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 48px; margin-bottom: 48px; }
.footer-logo { font-family: var(--pd); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 900; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.footer-tagline { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.3); max-width: 280px; line-height: 1.75; }
.footer-badges { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 14px; }
.footer-badges span { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius: 999px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.3); }
.footer-col h5 { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--honey2); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.footer-col a { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); margin-bottom: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: .15s; }
.footer-col a:hover { color: #fff; }
.footer-bottom { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07); padding-top: 20px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 8.5px; letter-spacing: .5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.2); line-height: 1.8; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media(max-width:1000px) {
  .wb-grid, .ritual-grid, .footer-main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .dash-body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .dash-side { display: none; }
  .why-box { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .wellness-moods { grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); }
}
@media(max-width:640px) {
  .nav-links { display: none; }
  .wb-grid .wb-card { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06); }
  .ritual-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .mv5-hero { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
  .vis-compare { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cost-builder .cb-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .metrics-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .wellness-moods { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); }
}
</style>
</head>

<!-- WHY BUY -->
<section id="why-buy">

function scrollToSection(id) {

// ── HERO / MOOD ──
const MOODS = {
  glow: { accent:'proves itself.', sub:'Raw forest honey. 6–12% curcumin turmeric. GI-certified chilli. Not claims — NABL lab certificates.' },
  heal: { accent:'heals you.', sub:'Lakadong turmeric with 6–12% curcumin. Not the pale yellow powder in your cupboard.' },
  fire: { accent:'changes everything.', sub:'One pod. Entire meal. 1,041,427 SHU. Bhut Jolokia at micro-dose is 96% cheaper per dish.' },
  sleep: { accent:'restores you.', sub:'Raw forest honey before bed. Cliff honey elixir at body temperature. Ancient NE food rituals.' },
  energy: { accent:'energises you.', sub:'Hill kiwi at 44 hours fresh. Jalukee pineapple at Brix 17–22°.' },
  comfort: { accent:'nourishes you.', sub:'Akhuni dal. Chak-Hao black rice bowl. Ancient NE fermentation meets the modern kitchen.' }
};
function setMood(mood, btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.mood-pill').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  const m = MOODS[mood];
  if (m) {
    document.getElementById('hero-accent').textContent = m.accent;
    document.getElementById('hero-sub').textContent = m.sub;
  }
  drawCanvas(mood);
}
function drawCanvas(mood) {
  const c = document.getElementById('hero-canvas');
  if (!c) return;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  c.width = c.offsetWidth; c.height = c.offsetHeight;
  const colors = { glow:['#1a1000','rgba(200,120,10,0.4)'], heal:['#0a1400','rgba(38,112,64,0.4)'], fire:['#1a0400','rgba(168,52,24,0.4)'], sleep:['#080a18','rgba(80,40,160,0.4)'], energy:['#081200','rgba(30,80,48,0.4)'], comfort:['#140a00','rgba(107,64,32,0.4)'] };
  const col = colors[mood] || colors.glow;
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.width*.65, c.height*.25, 0, c.width*.5, c.height*.5, Math.max(c.width,c.height));
  g.addColorStop(0, col[1]); g.addColorStop(0.6, col[0]); g.addColorStop(1, col[0]);
  ctx.fillStyle = col[0]; ctx.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.04)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(Math.random()*c.width, Math.random()*c.height, Math.random()*2+1, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
}
window.addEventListener('resize', () => drawCanvas(document.querySelector('.mood-pill.active')?.dataset?.mood || 'glow'));
setTimeout(() => drawCanvas('glow'), 100);

// ── TOAST ──
function showToast(icon, title, sub) {
  const container = document.getElementById('toast-container');
  if (!container) return;
  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = 'toast';
  toast.innerHTML = `<span class="toast-icon">${icon}</span><div class="toast-body"><div class="toast-title">${title}</div><div class="toast-sub">${sub}</div></div><button class="toast-close" onclick="this.parentElement.remove()">✕</button>`;
  container.appendChild(toast);
  setTimeout(() => { toast.classList.add('removing'); setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300); }, 4000);
}

        <div class="pc5-badges"><span class="pc5-badge pb-season-${p.season}">${p.seasonLabel}</span>${p.gi ? `<span class="pc5-badge pb-gi">${p.gi}</span>` : ''}</div>
        <span class="pc5-art">${p.emoji}</span><span class="pc5-qty-note">${p.qtyNote}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="pc5-body">
        <div class="pc5-category">${p.cat.toUpperCase()}</div>
        <div class="pc5-name">${p.name}</div>
        <div class="pc5-tagline">${p.tagline.substring(0,80)}${p.tagline.length>80?'…':''}</div>
        <div class="pc5-claim"><span class="pc5-claim-bg">${p.emoji}</span><div class="pc5-claim-main">${p.claim}</div><div class="pc5-claim-sub">Click to see proof →</div></div>
        <div class="pc5-footer"><div class="pc5-price-wrap"><span class="pc5-price">${p.price}</span><span class="pc5-price-note">${p.priceNote}</span></div>
        <button class="btn btn-forest btn-sm" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openModal('${p.id}')">See science</button></div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}
function filterProducts(cat, btn) {
  currentFilter = cat;
  if (btn) { document.querySelectorAll('.pfv5').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('on')); btn.classList.add('on'); }
  renderProducts();
}
function buildFilters() {
  const bar = document.getElementById('filter-bar');
  if (!bar) return;
  const cats = ['all','honey','spice','fruit','grain','fermented'];
  const labels = ['All','🍯 Honey','🌶 Spices','🍍 Fruits','🍚 Grains','🫘 Fermented'];
  bar.innerHTML = cats.map((c,i) => `<button class="pfv5 ${i===0?'on':''}" onclick="filterProducts('${c}',this)">${labels[i]}</button>`).join('');
}

// ── MODAL ──
let currentProduct = null;
function openModal(id) {
  const p = PRODUCTS.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!p) return;
  currentProduct = p;
  document.getElementById('modal-art').innerHTML = p.emoji;
  document.getElementById('modal-cat').textContent = p.cat.toUpperCase() + (p.origin ? ' · ' + p.origin.split('·')[0].trim() : '');
  document.getElementById('modal-claim').innerHTML = p.claim;
  document.getElementById('modal-tagline').textContent = p.tagline;
  // Why
  document.getElementById('modal-why-content').innerHTML = p.why ? `<div class="why-box">${p.why.map(w => `<div class="wb-item"><div class="wb-item-icon">${w.icon}</div><div class="wb-item-title">${w.t}</div><div class="wb-item-body">${w.b}</div></div>`).join('')}</div>` : '<p>No data</p>';
  // Compare
  document.getElementById('modal-compare-content').innerHTML = p.compare ? `<div class="vis-compare"><div class="vc-col theirs"><div class="vc-label">Typical market</div><ul class="vc-list">${p.compare.theirs.map(t => `<li>${t}</li>`).join('')}</ul></div><div class="vc-col ours"><div class="vc-label">NE Harvest</div><ul class="vc-list">${p.compare.ours.map(t => `<li>${t}</li>`).join('')}</ul></div></div>` : '<p>No comparison data</p>';
  // Recipe
  document.getElementById('modal-recipe-content').innerHTML = p.recipe ? `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;"><span style="font-size:24px;">${p.recipe.mood}</span><div><div style="font-family:var(--pd);font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--f);">${p.recipe.name}</div><div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;color:var(--g400);">${p.recipe.time}</div></div></div><div class="recipe-steps">${p.recipe.steps.map((s,i) => `<div class="rs-step"><div class="rs-num">${i+1}</div><div class="rs-text">${s}</div></div>`).join('')}</div><div style="background:var(--fp);padding:12px;border-radius:var(--r-md);font-size:12px;color:var(--f);">${p.recipe.note}</div>` : '<p>No recipe</p>';
  // Calculator
  const calc = p.calc || {};
  document.getElementById('modal-calc-content').innerHTML = `<div class="ctx-calc"><div class="cc-title">Per-use cost calculator</div><div class="cc-sub">How much do you actually need, and what does it cost?</div><div class="cc-controls"><div><label>Quantity (${calc.unit||'g'})</label><input class="cc-input" type="number" id="calc-qty-modal" value="${calc.ourDose||10}" min="0.01" step="0.01" oninput="updateModalCalc()"></div></div><div class="cc-result" id="modal-calc-result"></div></div>`;
  updateModalCalc();
  // Trace
  const trace = p.trace || {};
  document.getElementById('modal-trace-content').innerHTML = `<div style="background:var(--g50);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:20px;"><div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;">${Object.entries(trace).map(([k,v]) => `<div><div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;color:var(--g300);">${k.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+k.slice(1)}</div><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;">${v}</div></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
  // Order
  document.getElementById('modal-order-content').innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center;padding:16px;"><div style="font-family:var(--pd);font-size:32px;font-weight:900;color:var(--f);">${p.price}</div><div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--g300);">${p.priceNote}</div><div style="display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:16px 0;"><button class="btn btn-honey btn-lg" onclick="addToCart('${p.id}')">Add to cart 🛒</button></div></div>`;
  // Reset tabs
  document.querySelectorAll('.mv5-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('on'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.mv5-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('on'));
  document.querySelector('.mv5-tab').classList.add('on');
  document.getElementById('panel-why').classList.add('on');
  document.getElementById('modal-overlay').classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('modal-overlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
function handleModalOverlay(e) { if (e.target === document.getElementById('modal-overlay')) closeModal(); }
function updateModalCalc() {
  const p = currentProduct;
  if (!p) return;
  const calc = p.calc || {};
  const qty = parseFloat(document.getElementById('calc-qty-modal')?.value) || calc.ourDose || 10;
  const oc = ((calc.ourKg||0) / 1000) * qty;
  const gc = ((calc.genKg||0) / 1000) * qty * ((calc.genDose||qty) / (calc.ourDose||qty));
  const res = document.getElementById('modal-calc-result');
  if (!res) return;
  if (calc.special) {
    res.innerHTML = `<div class="cc-result-main">₹${oc.toFixed(2)}</div><div class="cc-result-sub">${calc.special}</div>`;
  } else {
    const saving = calc.genKg > 0 ? Math.round((1 - oc/gc) * 100) : 0;
    res.innerHTML = `<div class="cc-result-main">₹${oc.toFixed(2)}</div><div class="cc-result-sub">for ${qty}${calc.unit} — per ${calc.metric||'use'}</div>${calc.genKg>0?`<div class="cc-result-sub" style="opacity:.7;">${calc.genName}: ₹${gc.toFixed(2)} · You save ${saving}%</div>`:''}`;
  }
}
// Modal tab switching
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  const tab = e.target.closest('.mv5-tab');
  if (tab) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.mv5-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('on'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.mv5-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('on'));
    tab.classList.add('on');
    document.getElementById('panel-'+tab.dataset.panel).classList.add('on');
    if (tab.dataset.panel === 'calc') updateModalCalc();
  }
});

}

// ── COST BUILDER ──
function renderCostBuilder() {
  const container = document.getElementById('cost-builder-container');
  if (!container) return;
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="cost-builder"><div class="cb-row"><div><label class="cb-label">Product</label><select class="cb-select" id="cb-prod" onchange="buildCost()">${Object.keys(COSTS).map(k => `<option value="${k}">${k.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+k.slice(1)} (₹${COSTS[k].proc} farm gate)</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div><label class="cb-label">Volume</label><select class="cb-select" id="cb-vol" onchange="buildCost()"><option value="100">100 kg (pilot)</option><option value="500">500 kg (small)</option><option value="1000">1,000 kg (medium)</option><option value="5000">5,000 kg (scale)</option></select></div></div>
    <div class="cost-stack" id="cost-stack-out"></div>
    <div class="margin-cards" id="margin-cards-out"></div></div>`;
  buildCost();
}
function buildCost() {
  const d = COSTS[document.getElementById('cb-prod').value];
  const vol = parseInt(document.getElementById('cb-vol').value);
  if (!d) return;
  const apmc = Math.round(d.proc * d.apmc * 100) / 100;
  const sort = Math.round(d.proc * d.sort * 100) / 100;
  const t = d.proc + apmc + sort + d.pack + d.road + d.rail + d.ndls + d.transit + d.admin;
  const mc = Math.round((1 - t / d.sellC) * 100);
  const mo = Math.round((1 - t / d.sellO) * 100);
  const sv = Math.round((1 - d.sellC / d.bb) * 100);
  const rev = Math.round(vol * d.sellC / 100) / 100;
  const prof = Math.round(vol * (d.sellC - t) / 100) / 100;
  document.getElementById('cost-stack-out').innerHTML = `
    <div class="cs-row"><span class="cs-lbl">A. Procurement</span><span class="cs-val">₹${d.proc}</span><span class="cs-pct">${Math.round(d.proc/t*100)}%</span></div>
    <div class="cs-row"><span class="cs-lbl">B. APMC levy</span><span class="cs-val">₹${apmc.toFixed(2)}</span><span class="cs-pct">${Math.round(apmc/t*100)}%</span></div>
    <div class="cs-row"><span class="cs-lbl">C. Sort/grade loss</span><span class="cs-val">₹${sort.toFixed(2)}</span><span class="cs-pct">${Math.round(sort/t*100)}%</span></div>
    <div class="cs-row"><span class="cs-lbl">D. Packaging</span><span class="cs-val">₹${d.pack}</span><span class="cs-pct">${Math.round(d.pack/t*100)}%</span></div>
    <div class="cs-row"><span class="cs-lbl">E. Kohima→Dimapur road</span><span class="cs-val" style="color:var(--f);">₹${d.road}</span><span class="cs-pct">${Math.round(d.road/t*100)}%</span></div>
    <div class="cs-row"><span class="cs-lbl">F. Rail freight (Op Green)</span><span class="cs-val" style="color:var(--f);">₹${d.rail}</span><span class="cs-pct">${Math.round(d.rail/t*100)}%</span></div>
    <div class="cs-row"><span class="cs-lbl">G. NDLS→Gurgaon last-mile</span><span class="cs-val">₹${d.ndls}</span><span class="cs-pct">${Math.round(d.ndls/t*100)}%</span></div>
    <div class="cs-row"><span class="cs-lbl">H. Transit damage</span><span class="cs-val">₹${d.transit}</span><span class="cs-pct">${Math.round(d.transit/t*100)}%</span></div>
    <div class="cs-row"><span class="cs-lbl">I. Admin overhead</span><span class="cs-val">₹${d.admin}</span><span class="cs-pct">${Math.round(d.admin/t*100)}%</span></div>
    <div class="cs-row"><span class="cs-lbl" style="color:var(--ll);">TOTAL LANDED COST</span><span class="cs-val" style="color:#fff;">₹${t.toFixed(2)}/kg</span><span class="cs-pct" style="color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);">floor</span></div>`;
  document.getElementById('margin-cards-out').innerHTML = `
    <div class="mc-card mc-primary"><div class="mc-val">${mc}%</div><div class="mc-lbl">Margin (conv) · ₹${d.sellC}/kg</div></div>
    <div class="mc-card mc-green"><div class="mc-val" style="color:var(--f);">${mo}%</div><div class="mc-lbl">Margin (organic) · ₹${d.sellO}/kg</div></div>
    <div class="mc-card mc-gold"><div class="mc-val" style="color:var(--honey);">${sv}%</div><div class="mc-lbl">Saving vs BigBasket ₹${d.bb}/kg</div></div>
    <div class="mc-card" style="background:var(--g50);"><div class="mc-val" style="font-size:18px;color:var(--f);">₹${rev.toFixed(1)}L</div><div class="mc-lbl">Revenue for ${vol}kg</div></div>
    <div class="mc-card" style="background:var(--lp);"><div class="mc-val" style="font-size:18px;color:var(--f);">₹${prof.toFixed(1)}L</div><div class="mc-lbl">Gross profit for ${vol}kg</div></div>`;
}

// ── BAZAR RATES ──
let bazarPage = 1;
const rowsPerPage = 10;
function renderBazar(page) {
  bazarPage = page || bazarPage;
  const tbody = document.getElementById('bazar-body');
  if (!tbody) return;
  const start = (bazarPage - 1) * rowsPerPage;
  const end = start + rowsPerPage;
  const data = BAZAR_RATES.slice(start, end);
  tbody.innerHTML = data.map(row => `<tr><td>${row.date}</td><td>Current Bazar Rate</td><td><a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="showToast('📥','Download initiated','File ID: ${row.id}')">Download</a></td></tr>`).join('');
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(BAZAR_RATES.length / rowsPerPage);
  const pag = document.getElementById('pagination');
  if (!pag) return;
  let html = '';
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
    html += `<button class="page-btn ${i===bazarPage?'active':''}" onclick="renderBazar(${i})">${i}</button>`;
  }
  pag.innerHTML = html;
}

// ── CART ──
let cart = [];
function addToCart(id) {
  const p = PRODUCTS.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!p) return;
  const existing = cart.find(i => i.id === id);
  if (existing) existing.qty++;
  else cart.push({ id, qty: 1 });
  updateCartUI();
  showToast('🛒', `${p.name} added`, `Cart: ${cart.reduce((a,i) => a + i.qty, 0)} items`);
  if (document.getElementById('modal-overlay').classList.contains('open')) closeModal();
}
function removeFromCart(id) {
  cart = cart.filter(i => i.id !== id);
  updateCartUI();
  renderCartItems();
}
function changeQty(id, delta) {
  const item = cart.find(i => i.id === id);
  if (!item) return;
  item.qty = Math.max(1, item.qty + delta);
  updateCartUI();
  renderCartItems();
}
function updateCartUI() {
  const count = cart.reduce((a, i) => a + i.qty, 0);
  const dot = document.getElementById('cart-dot');
  if (dot) { dot.textContent = count; dot.classList.toggle('show', count > 0); }
  document.getElementById('cart-header-count').textContent = `${count} item${count !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
  const total = cart.reduce((a, i) => {
    const p = PRODUCTS.find(x => x.id === i.id);
    if (!p) return a;
    const price = parseFloat(p.price.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) || 0;
    return a + price * i.qty;
  }, 0);
  document.getElementById('cart-total').textContent = '₹' + total.toLocaleString('en-IN');
  document.getElementById('cart-subtotal').textContent = '₹' + total.toLocaleString('en-IN');
}
function renderCartItems() {
  const el = document.getElementById('cart-items-list');
  if (!el) return;
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="cart-empty"><div class="cart-empty-icon">🛒</div><div class="cart-empty-text">Your cart is empty.</div><button class="btn btn-forest btn-sm" onclick="closeCart();scrollToSection('products')">Browse products</button></div>`;
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = cart.map(item => {
    const p = PRODUCTS.find(x => x.id === item.id);
    if (!p) return '';
    const price = parseFloat(p.price.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) || 0;
    return `<div class="cart-item"><div class="cart-item-img" style="background:${p.bg}">${p.emoji}</div><div class="cart-item-body"><div class="cart-item-name">${p.name}</div><div class="cart-item-origin">${p.origin||'NE India'}</div><div class="cart-item-controls"><button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty('${p.id}',-1)">−</button><span class="qty-num">${item.qty}</span><button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty('${p.id}',1)">+</button><span class="cart-remove" onclick="removeFromCart('${p.id}')">Remove</span></div></div><div class="cart-item-price">₹${(price*item.qty).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div></div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function openCart() {
  renderCartItems();
  document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeCart() {
  document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
function handleCartOverlay(e) { if (e.target === document.getElementById('cart-overlay')) closeCart(); }
function checkout() {
  if (cart.length === 0) return;
  showToast('🏦', 'Proceeding to escrow pre-payment', 'Money held until QR delivery confirmation');
  closeCart();
  setTimeout(() => showToast('✅', 'Order placed!', 'Saturday delivery at your RWA.'), 1500);
  cart = [];
  updateCartUI();
}

  buildFilters();
  renderProducts();

  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => io.observe(el));
  console.log('✅ NE Harvest — Complete Extraction Loaded');
}

Phase 0 – Analysis & Design	2 weeks	Finalise product backlog, UX wireframes, data model, API design.
Phase 1 – Backend & Database	4 weeks	PostgreSQL schema, Prisma models, core API endpoints, JWT auth, role‑based middleware.
Phase 2 – Frontend (Web)	6 weeks	Next.js app with pages: home, product listing, product detail, cart, checkout, dashboard. Integrate with backend APIs.
Phase 3 – Admin/Operational Dashboards	4 weeks	Farmer, FPO, RWA, Bank portals with real data.
Phase 4 – Payment & Order Management	3 weeks	Razorpay integration, escrow simulation, order workflow.
Phase 5 – WhatsApp Integration	3 weeks	Webhook, template management, two‑way conversation, notifications.
Phase 6 – Mobile App (React Native)	6 weeks	Consumer app: shop, cart, orders, QR scan. Farmer app (simplified) for stock declaration.
Phase 7 – Desktop App (Electron)	2 weeks	Wrap web app.
Phase 8 – AI/ML Features	6 weeks	Demand forecasting, scheme readiness, price optimisation.
Phase 9 – IoT & Traceability	4 weeks	MQTT integration, QR generation, batch trace.
Phase 10 – Testing & Deployment	4 weeks	E2E tests, performance tuning, production deployment, documentation.
Total estimated effort: ~44 weeks (≈ 11 months) for a full‑scale product.

6. RISKS & MITIGATIONS
Risk	Mitigation
Data sourcing (USDA, APMC)	Use USDA FDC API; for APMC, either scrape or integrate with a data provider.
Regulatory compliance (FSSAI, GI)	Involve legal counsel; build compliance checklists into the platform.
WhatsApp API restrictions	Follow Meta’s policies; use templates strictly; monitor opt‑outs.
Payment escrow complexity	Partner with a licensed payment aggregator (Razorpay has escrow solutions).
Farmer adoption	Start with pilot FPOs; use WhatsApp as the primary interface (low tech barrier).
AI model accuracy	Start with simple rule‑based heuristics; collect data for ML later.
7. CONCLUSION & NEXT STEPS
The existing prototype is an excellent UI/UX concept but lacks the backend infrastructure, data, and integrations required for a production system. To move forward, we recommend:

Finalise the technology stack and create a detailed project plan.

Set up the development environment (monorepo, Docker, CI/CD).

Begin with Phase 1 (database + core APIs) and Phase 2 (web frontend) in parallel.

Engage with Deep Seek AI to generate boilerplate code for each module (schemas, CRUD APIs, React components) using our detailed specifications.

By following this comprehensive blueprint, you will have a complete, professional, multi‑channel platform that can scale and adapt to market needs.

IoT Integration – no real MQTT or WebSocket data.

QR Code Generation – no actual QR generation or scanning.

Multi‑language – no i18n support.

Testing – no unit or E2E tests.

CI/CD – no deployment scripts or configuration.

NE HARVEST / AO SYSTEM — ULTRA‑COMPREHENSIVE MODULE ANALYSIS
Complete Inventory, Cross‑File Comparison & Professional Development Roadmap
This document provides a zero‑loss, exhaustive analysis of every module, component, data structure, and interaction present across the 12 provided HTML files. It identifies the best implementation of each feature, highlights inconsistencies and gaps, and proposes a unified plan to integrate everything into a production‑ready, multi‑channel platform (web, mobile, desktop, WhatsApp, AI, IoT).

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
The 12 HTML files represent a rich, multi‑sided agricultural ecosystem with:

Consumer e‑commerce (mood‑based shopping, science‑backed product cards, recipes, wellness, rituals, seasonal CSA).

Role‑based portals (9+ stakeholder dashboards: farmer, FPO, bank, RWA, HoReCa, etc.).

AI demand grid and AI intelligence dashboard.

Supply chain visibility (cold chain, traceability, landed cost builder).

Government scheme guidance (readiness scores, official portal routing).

APMC bazar rates (market data with pagination).

Business report with 23 sections (financials, moats, team, etc.).

Critical observation: While each file has polished UI and conceptual data, all are client‑side only – no backend, database, authentication, or real‑time API integration. Features vary in completeness across files; some modules appear in multiple files with different levels of sophistication. The best version of each module must be merged and backed by a proper full‑stack architecture.

5. RECOMMENDATION FOR PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
To build a complete, production‑ready platform that encompasses all features, we recommend the following architecture and stack:

5.1 Technology Stack
Layer	Technology	Rationale
Frontend (Web)	React 18 + TypeScript + Next.js (App Router)	SSR, SEO, API routes, dynamic routing, large ecosystem.
Mobile	React Native (Expo)	Code sharing with web; fast development.
Desktop	Electron (or Tauri)	Wrap web app for Windows/macOS/Linux.
Backend API	Node.js (Express) + TypeScript	RESTful API with JWT, role‑based access control.
Database	PostgreSQL (with Prisma ORM)	Relational data: users, products, orders, inventory, farmers, etc.
Cache	Redis	Session storage, rate limiting, caching of API responses.
File Storage	AWS S3 / Cloudinary	Product images, lab certificates, QR codes.
Payment	Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking) + Escrow integration	Escrow‑backed payments.
WhatsApp	WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Meta)	Inbound/outbound messages, templates, notifications.
AI/ML	Python FastAPI microservice (or TensorFlow.js)	Demand forecasting, price optimisation, scheme readiness.
IoT	MQTT broker + WebSocket	Real‑time cold chain temperature data.
Real‑time	Socket.IO	Live order updates, notifications.
Search	Elasticsearch / Algolia	Product search with filters.
Logging/Monitoring	Winston + Sentry + Prometheus	Error tracking and performance monitoring.
DevOps	Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, AWS/Azure/GCP	CI/CD, auto‑scaling, infrastructure as code.
5.2 Data Model (Core Tables)
Users (with roles: consumer, farmer, fpo, panchayat, logistics, bank, rwa, horeca, admin)

Products (with variety, season, gi_tag, lab_cert_url, brix, curcumin, shu, etc.)

ProductVariants (different SKUs per product)

Farmers (linked to user_id, with farm location, FPO id)

FPOs (cooperative details)

Orders (with status, payment_id, escrow_id)

OrderItems

Inventory (batch tracking)

PriceComparison (historical prices from platforms)

SchemeReadiness (scores per FPO)

CropStages (for CSA journeys)

Telemetry (IoT temperature logs)

Notifications (in‑app, WhatsApp, email)

Translations (for multi‑language support)

5.3 API Endpoints (Core)
/api/auth/register, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/me

/api/products (GET with filters, pagination)

/api/products/:id (GET full details)

/api/products/:id/varieties

/api/cart (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)

/api/orders (POST with payment initiation)

/api/orders/:id (GET details and status)

/api/orders/:id/track (shipment tracking)

/api/rwa/orders (bulk orders)

/api/fpo/dashboard (metrics)

/api/farmer/stock (POST stock declaration)

/api/farmer/payments (GET history)

/api/schemes/readiness (GET score)

/api/schemes/apply (generate application docs)

/api/rates (GET current APMC rates)

/api/whatsapp/webhook (POST incoming messages)

/api/iot/temperature (POST IoT data)

/api/ai/forecast (GET demand forecast)

/api/esg/metrics (GET CSR/ESG data)

5.4 Development Phases
Phase 0: Analysis & Design (2 weeks) – Finalise product backlog, UX wireframes, data model, API design.

Phase 1: Backend & Database (4 weeks) – PostgreSQL schema, Prisma models, core API endpoints, JWT auth.

Phase 2: Frontend (Web) (6 weeks) – Next.js app with pages: home, product listing, product detail, cart, checkout, dashboard.

Phase 3: Admin/Operational Dashboards (4 weeks) – Farmer, FPO, RWA, Bank portals with real data.

Phase 4: Payment & Order Management (3 weeks) – Razorpay integration, escrow simulation, order workflow.

Phase 5: WhatsApp Integration (3 weeks) – Webhook, templates, two‑way conversation.

Phase 6: Mobile App (6 weeks) – React Native consumer app, farmer app (simplified).

Phase 7: Desktop App (2 weeks) – Electron wrap.

Phase 8: AI/ML Features (6 weeks) – Demand forecasting, scheme readiness, price optimisation.

Phase 9: IoT & Traceability (4 weeks) – MQTT integration, QR generation, batch trace.

Phase 10: Testing & Deployment (4 weeks) – E2E tests, performance tuning, production deployment.

Total estimated effort: ~44 weeks (≈ 11 months).

🎯 RECOMMENDATION FOR PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Full Stack Architecture
Layer	Technology	Purpose
Frontend (Web)	React 18 + TypeScript + Next.js (App Router)	SSR, SEO, API routes, dynamic routing
Mobile	React Native (Expo)	iOS and Android apps sharing business logic
Desktop	Electron (or Tauri)	Wraps the web app for Windows/macOS/Linux
Backend API	Node.js (Express) + TypeScript	RESTful API with JWT, role-based access control
Database	PostgreSQL (with Prisma ORM)	Relational data: users, products, orders, inventory, farmers
Cache	Redis	Session storage, rate limiting, caching
File Storage	AWS S3 / Cloudinary	Product images, lab certificates, QR codes
Payment	Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking) + Escrow integration	Escrow-backed payments
WhatsApp	WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Meta)	Inbound/outbound messages, templates, notifications
AI/ML	Python FastAPI microservice (or TensorFlow.js)	Demand forecasting, price optimisation, scheme readiness
IoT	MQTT broker + WebSocket	Real-time cold chain temperature data
Real-time	Socket.IO	Live order updates, notifications
Search	Elasticsearch / Algolia	Product search with filters
Logging/Monitoring	Winston + Sentry + Prometheus	Error tracking and performance monitoring
DevOps	Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, AWS/Azure/GCP	CI/CD, auto-scaling, infrastructure as code
Data Model (Core Tables)
sql
-- Users (with role: consumer, farmer, fpo, panchayat, logistics, bank, rwa, horeca, admin)
-- Products (with variety, season, gi_tag, lab_cert_url, brix, curcumin, shu, etc.)
-- ProductVariants (different SKUs per product)
-- Farmers (linked to user_id, with farm location, FPO id)
-- FPOs (cooperative details)
-- Orders (with status, payment_id, escrow_id)
-- OrderItems
-- Inventory (batch tracking)
-- PriceComparison (historical prices from platforms)
-- SchemeReadiness (scores per FPO)
-- CropStages (for CSA journeys)
-- Telemetry (IoT temperature logs)
-- Notifications (in-app, WhatsApp, email)
-- Translations (for multi-language support)
-- CSRProjects (bamboo, pollinator, watershed, etc.)
-- ProcessingUnits (25 units with setup cost, margin, output)
API Endpoints (Core)
Endpoint	Method	Description
/api/auth/register	POST	User registration with role
/api/auth/login	POST	JWT-based login
/api/auth/me	GET	Current user profile
/api/products	GET	Search/filter products (with pagination, sorting)
/api/products/:id	GET	Full product details (including science, comparisons)
/api/products/:id/varieties	GET	List of varieties for a product
/api/cart	GET/POST/PUT/DELETE	Manage user cart (Redis-backed)
/api/orders	POST	Create order with payment initiation
/api/orders/:id	GET	Order details and status
/api/orders/:id/track	GET	Shipment tracking (cold chain data)
/api/rwa/orders	GET	RWA bulk orders
/api/fpo/dashboard	GET	FPO metrics (demand, procurement)
/api/farmer/stock	POST	Farmer declares stock via WhatsApp/web
/api/farmer/payments	GET	Payment history
/api/schemes/readiness	GET	FPO readiness score
/api/schemes/apply	POST	Generate application docs (redirect to Govt portal)
/api/rates	GET	Current APMC bazar rates (scraped or via API)
/api/whatsapp/webhook	POST	Incoming WhatsApp messages
/api/iot/temperature	POST	IoT device data ingestion
/api/ai/forecast	GET	Demand forecast for a product (AI microservice)
/api/esg/metrics	GET	CSR/ESG dashboard data
/api/processing/units	GET	List of 25 processing units
/api/csa/reserve	POST	Reserve seasonal produce
/api/recipes	GET	Ritual/recipe data
Development Phases
Phase	Duration	Deliverables
Phase 0 – Analysis & Design	2 weeks	Finalise product backlog, UX wireframes, data model, API design
Phase 1 – Backend & Database	4 weeks	PostgreSQL schema, Prisma models, core API endpoints, JWT auth, role-based middleware
Phase 2 – Frontend (Web)	6 weeks	Next.js app with pages: home, product listing, product detail, cart, checkout, dashboard
Phase 3 – Admin/Operational Dashboards	4 weeks	Farmer, FPO, RWA, Bank portals with real data
Phase 4 – Payment & Order Management	3 weeks	Razorpay integration, escrow simulation, order workflow
Phase 5 – WhatsApp Integration	3 weeks	Webhook, template management, two-way conversation, notifications
Phase 6 – Mobile App (React Native)	6 weeks	Consumer app: shop, cart, orders, QR scan. Farmer app (simplified) for stock declaration
Phase 7 – Desktop App (Electron)	2 weeks	Wrap web app
Phase 8 – AI/ML Features	6 weeks	Demand forecasting, scheme readiness, price optimisation
Phase 9 – IoT & Traceability	4 weeks	MQTT integration, QR generation, batch trace
Phase 10 – Testing & Deployment	4 weeks	E2E tests, performance tuning, production deployment
Total estimated effort: ~44 weeks (≈ 11 months) for a full-scale product.

backend/prisma/schema.prisma
prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// ── Core User & Roles ──
model User {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  email         String    @unique
  passwordHash  String
  name          String?
  role          UserRole  @default(CONSUMER)
  phone         String?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt
  farmer        Farmer?
  fpo           FPO?
  orders        Order[]
  cart          Cart?
}

enum UserRole {
  CONSUMER
  FARMER
  FPO
  PANCHAYAT
  LOGISTICS
  BANK
  RWA
  HORECA
  CSR
  ADMIN
}

// ── Farmer ──
model Farmer {
  id          Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId      Int      @unique
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  farmName    String?
  village     String?
  district    String?
  state       String
  latitude    Float?
  longitude   Float?
  fpoId       Int?
  fpo         FPO?     @relation(fields: [fpoId], references: [id])
  fpcMember   Boolean  @default(false)
  products    Product[]
  stock       Stock[]
  payments    Payment[]
}

// ── FPO ──
model FPO {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  name          String
  registration  String?   // CIN or FPC registration
  members       Int       @default(0)
  villages      String[]
  schemeReadiness Json?   // AI readiness score
  farmers       Farmer[]
  products      Product[]
  orders        Order[]
}

// ── Products ──
model Product {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  name          String
  variety       String?
  category      String    // honey, spice, fruit, grain, fermented, coffee
  season        String?   // peak, limited, rare, year
  giTag         String?   // GI: Naga Mircha, etc.
  origin        String?
  altitude      Int?
  description   String
  claim         String
  price         Float
  priceNote     String?
  unit          String    // kg, g, tsp, etc.
  images        String[]  // URLs
  bgColor       String    // for card background
  emoji         String
  scienceRows   Json      // [{label, value, class}]
  scienceStory  String
  why           Json      // [{icon, title, body}]
  compareTheirs Json
  compareOurs   Json
  recipeName    String
  recipeMood    String
  recipeTime    String
  recipeSteps   String[]
  recipeNote    String
  recipeKit     String[]
  calcUnit      String
  calcOurKg     Float
  calcGenKg     Float
  calcOurDose   Float
  calcGenDose   Float
  calcGenName   String
  calcMetric    String
  calcSpecial   String?
  traceFarm     String
  traceFarmer   String
  traceDate     String
  traceBatch    String
  traceCert     String
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt
  farmerId      Int?
  farmer        Farmer?   @relation(fields: [farmerId], references: [id])
  fpoId         Int?
  fpo           FPO?      @relation(fields: [fpoId], references: [id])
  inventory     Inventory[]
  orderItems    OrderItem[]
}

// ── Inventory (batch tracking) ──
model Inventory {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  productId     Int
  product       Product   @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
  batchId       String    @unique
  quantity      Float
  unit          String
  harvestDate   DateTime
  expiryDate    DateTime?
  labCertUrl    String?
  temperatureLog Json?    // IoT data
  status        String    // available, sold, expired
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
}

// ── Stock Declaration (farmer) ──
model Stock {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  farmerId      Int
  farmer        Farmer    @relation(fields: [farmerId], references: [id])
  productId     Int
  product       Product   @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
  quantity      Float
  unit          String
  harvestDate   DateTime
  status        String    // pending, confirmed, collected
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
}

// ── Cart ──
model Cart {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId        Int       @unique
  user          User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  items         Json      // [{productId, qty, variant}]
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt
}

// ── Orders ──
model Order {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId        Int
  user          User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  fpoId         Int?
  fpo           FPO?      @relation(fields: [fpoId], references: [id])
  status        String    // pending, paid, processing, shipped, delivered
  paymentId     String?
  escrowId      String?
  total         Float
  items         OrderItem[]
  shippingAddress Json
  deliverySlot  String?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model OrderItem {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  orderId       Int
  order         Order     @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id])
  productId     Int
  product       Product   @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
  qty           Float
  unitPrice     Float
  totalPrice    Float
  inventoryId   Int?      // linked to specific batch
}

// ── Payments ──
model Payment {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  farmerId      Int
  farmer        Farmer    @relation(fields: [farmerId], references: [id])
  amount        Float
  type          String    // escrow, direct, scheme
  status        String    // pending, released
  transactionId String?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
}

// ── CSA Reservations ──
model CsaReservation {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId        Int
  user          User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  productId     Int
  product       Product   @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
  quantity      Float
  season        String
  status        String    // reserved, fulfilled, cancelled
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
}

// ── Scheme Readiness (for FPO) ──
model SchemeReadiness {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  fpoId         Int
  fpo           FPO       @relation(fields: [fpoId], references: [id])
  schemeName    String    // PMFME, MOVCD-NER, etc.
  score         Int       // 0-100
  checklist     Json
  lastUpdated   DateTime  @default(now())
}

// ── IoT Telemetry ──
model Telemetry {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  nodeId        String
  productId     Int?
  product       Product?  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
  temperature   Float
  humidity      Float?
  timestamp     DateTime  @default(now())
}

// ── Bazar Rate (APMC) ──
model BazarRate {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  date          DateTime
  commodity     String
  price         Float
  unit          String
  source        String?   // APMC, etc.
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
}
